Hi Ethan — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot.

Short answer: it looks like a duplicate/shadow identity issue. When an invite lands on an address that already has a lightweight guest account on our portal (often created previously with a consumer Google login), the onboarding flow can put you into that guest profile which doesn't have the verified company-level sections (banking, tax docs) visible.

Two quick options:
- If you can sign in with the corporate email address we have on file (ethan.cross@greenfieldsupplies.com) and accept the claim, that usually merges to the company profile and the bank fields reappear.
- If you can't access that corporate account, I can raise a manual merge with Ops to link the consumer account to your company record so Banking and W-9 upload are unlocked.

Ben, I think this is one we should do a manual merge for — they're timing-sensitive (first PO). Can you take point?

Ethan/Monica — I'm attaching the W-9 upload instructions and a DG (doc link) for the manual merge process in case you want to follow along. If you prefer, I can have Ops do the merge and confirm back here.

Best,
